items.title: Chester Zardis Interview, 1966-03-09
items.q: No, I didn't play with... every time that Manuel had wanted me... He'd say, boy I'd like to get you to play in my band.

ctx.x: Somebody told me Manuel Perez was playing with the Onward too. How did he sound?

Manuel? I was a sweet trumpet player. Did you ever play with him? No, I didn't play with, every time that Manuel had wanted me, looked like that same boy that would be all you know. And he'd tell me, he'd say, boy I'd like to get you to play in my band. He'd say, but by the time you turn around you're playing with Buddy. So I told him, I said, well you know how it is when you started up with a bunch. I said, you like to be with them, you know what I mean?
So he said, well yeah you're right.
